ownerDecisions: Project, folder and assembly names are the namespace root of the module (owner decision 2026-11-19, see docs/codec-base-porting.md): each codec module takes the namespace of its main package, and the tests use <project>.Tests like the other test projects.

Owner decisions 2026-11-19 for the codec modules that only need codec-base: one project per Maven module; codec-socks is Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Socks (its Maven and JPMS name) and holds the socks and socksx namespaces; haproxy is HAProxy (the casing of the Java types in that package); socksx, v4 and v5 are Socksx, V4 and V5.

Owner decisions 2026-11-23: the project is Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Xml (casing of the Java types XmlDecoder, XmlFrameDecoder); units that need a third-party Java library without a BCL counterpart on .NET 10 are not ported (the codec-compression rule).

review.scope: Value type with the source fields, constructor, equals, hashCode and toString. The public accessors are virtual: a Java method that is not final can be overridden (JLS 8: "A method may be declared final ..., in which case it cannot be hidden or overridden"), while C# methods are non-virtual by default. equals/hashCode/toString are the overrides Equals(object)/GetHashCode()/ToString(). type() is Type() (no nested type of that name exists, so no clash), and the field namespace is @namespace, a C# keyword escaped with @. toString() writes a null field as "null" (Java string conversion, JLS 5.1.11), because C# concatenation writes null as an empty string. String.hashCode() is replaced by string.GetHashCode(), which "is not guaranteed to be stable": hash values differ from the JVM's, while equal objects still hash equally (the contract Equals relies on, as in the codec-dns AbstractDnsRecord port).

Source algorithm, fields, state reset and messages. decode(ctx, in, out) is the protected override Decode(IChannelHandlerContext ctx, ByteBuf @in, IList<object> @out) (docs/codec-base-porting.md); readerIndex()/writerIndex()/readableBytes() are Buffer port properties and checkPositive is the Common ObjectUtil.CheckPositive (ArgumentException). The labeled "break scan" is "goto scan" with the label on the first statement after the scan loop, because a labeled break exists only from C# 15 (the codec-compression mapping); the plain breaks inside the switch leave only the switch, as in Java. throw new Error() is UnreachableException (the java.lang.Error mapping of docs/codec-memcache-porting.md). The private enum BangMarkupKind is a simple C# enum. CDATA_START_SUFFIX casts its char constants with (byte), because C# converts char to byte only explicitly while Java narrows a representable constant (JLS 5.2). Character.isWhitespace(byte) is the private IsWhitespace(byte), which writes out the Java rule below 0x80 (U+0009-U+000D, U+001C-U+0020) as codec-base JsonObjectDecoder does; bytes 0x80-0xFF, negative after Java's sign-extending widening, are not white space in either language. Byte sign: GetByte returns an unsigned System.Byte (owner decision); every other read byte is compared with ASCII constants (<, >, /, !, ?, -, [, ], the CDATA[ letters, a-z, A-Z, :, _; all at most 0x7A), which 0x80-0xFF never equal or fall into in either language, so no cast is needed. Numbers in the TooLongFrameException messages use the invariant culture.
